reason: Article 5(1)(b) of the DORA Delegated Regulation requires entities to submit an updated intermediate report when the incident status changes materially. This directly supports the control objective of submitting an updated report upon a material change in incident status.
applicability_note: This control is specific to the reporting obligations for material changes in the status of a significant incident, as required by Article 5(1)(b) of the DORA Delegated Regulation.
challenge_comment: The mapping is adequate as it correctly identifies the specific regulatory provision that mandates the submission of an updated report upon a material change in incident status.
